summary: Two unidentified hikers attempting the Four Pass Loop lost their gear and were stranded near Snowmass Lake in the Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness, exposed to harsh winter-storm weather without shelter; SOS via Garmin inReach at 9:27 p.m. Sunday; four Mountain Rescue Aspen rescuers hiked in at 11:20 p.m. (helicopter rescue precluded by weather), located them at 5:04 a.m. Monday and escorted them down the Snowmass Creek Trail to the trailhead by 10:17 a.m.
location: Snowmass Lake / Four Pass Loop, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Incident date = Sunday 2024-06-30 SOS; rescue completed Monday 2024-07-01 (weekday-verified). Pitkin County Sheriff's Office issued a news release on the rescue (cited by SnowBrains). Both hikers uninjured but cold and wet.
